text:
olivia: Cascade security sent back the vendor form asking two things: 1) are embedding vectors encrypted at rest, and 2) how can they get them deleted on request? they want a concise answer for the form. :clipboard:

security-bot: See data protection note: https://redwood.internal/security/embeddings-retention (internal) :lock:

sam: Short answers: embeddings are encrypted at rest using customer keys for Dedicated/Private (KMS/HSM); Hosted uses our managed encryption keys. Retention: Hosted default 90 days for ephemeral caches and embeddings, Dedicated retention is configurable via contract, Private is fully customer-controlled.

june: For the form wording keep it simple. Suggested one-liner: "Embedding vectors derived from your data are encrypted at rest and retained as specified in your contract (Hosted default 90 days). Deletion can be requested via our support portal or the Data Deletion API; deletion workflows are asynchronous and may require additional time for backups to be purged."

olivia: nice. cascade also asked for the exact API endpoint they can call (they prefer API over opening a ticket). can we give a short curl example they can paste?

sam: Example (Hosted): ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/ACME123/data/deletions" 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"type":"embeddings","scope":"tenant","before":"2024-04-01","reason":"customer_request"}'
``` This returns a deletion_job_id. Finalization is async; typical completion 24-72 hours depending on indexes and backup schedules.

june: add a sentence clarifying that deleting embeddings doesn't remove tokens from model weights. we don't retrain hosted models on customer vectors.

sam: good call. reply line: "Note: deletion removes stored vectors and index entries; it does not affect model weights or any previously exported artifacts."

olivia: i'm going to paste a 3-sentence answer into the vendor form. DM me quick edits if you see anything off.

security-bot: Policy reminder: for customers requesting deletion evidence, CS should attach deletion_job_id + timestamp screenshot from the admin console.

june: i'll update the public DPA FAQ and the CS canned responses with this wording so reps have a copy-paste.

cs-bot: Created follow-up: /task create "Cascade - provide deletion instructions & evidence template" due:+2d assignee:@olivia

olivia: thanks team — sending to Cascade now. :airplane:

sam: thumbs up. if they want a signed attestation we can route to legal and security for a one-off artifact.

oljia: (typo) meant june above :)

june: noted. thanks everyone. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
